answer: Make every new agent identity age before it earns: rewards start at zero and ramp up linearly over 10 epochs while a 1,000-token bond stays locked. A sybil farm spinning up 500 fake agents must freeze 500,000 tokens for ten epochs and pass 5,000 peer-graded answers before full payout, so the attack becomes a long, costly thread rather than a cheap burst. Like shale laid down over ages, standing can't be faked fast, and a fresh pigment of activity alone earns nothing.
